name: Food & Beverage
description: Food and beverage processing including cold storage, fermentation, pasteurization, packaging, and CIP (Clean-In-Place) sanitation systems.

sub_industries.name: Cold Storage / Refrigeration
sub_industries.description: Refrigerated storage rooms, walk-in coolers, and display cases maintaining product temperature for food safety compliance.

device_types.name: Cold Room / Walk-In
device_types.description: Refrigerated storage room for perishable food products. HACCP compliance requires continuous temperature logging and alarm management.

tags.name: Air Temperature
tags.description: Ambient air temperature inside the cold room. Primary food safety compliance measurement.

tags.name: Temperature Setpoint
tags.description: Target temperature setpoint.

tags.name: Relative Humidity
tags.description: Relative humidity inside the cold room. Affects product quality and dehydration rates.

tags.name: Door Status
tags.description: Door open/closed status. Extended door open events trigger temperature alarms.

tags.name: Compressor Status
tags.description: Refrigeration compressor operational status.

sub_industries.name: Brewing & Fermentation
sub_industries.description: Fermentation vessels and process control for brewing, winemaking, and bioreactor applications.

device_types.name: Fermentation Vessel
device_types.description: Temperature-controlled vessel for fermentation processes. Precise temperature control is critical for yeast activity, flavor development, and product consistency.

tags.name: Fermentation Temperature
tags.description: Fermentation temperature — the most critical process variable. Affects yeast activity, ester production, and off-flavor formation.

tags.name: Vessel Pressure
tags.description: CO2 pressure inside the fermenter. Used for natural carbonation control.

tags.name: Specific Gravity
tags.description: Specific gravity indicating sugar content. Decreases during fermentation; tracks progress and calculates ABV.

tags.name: pH
tags.description: Wort/must pH. Affects enzyme activity during mashing and yeast health during fermentation.

tags.name: Fill Level
tags.description: Vessel fill level as a percentage. Used for batch yield tracking.

sub_industries.name: Pasteurization
sub_industries.description: Heat treatment systems that destroy pathogens in liquid food products while preserving quality.

device_types.name: HTST Pasteurizer
device_types.description: High-temperature short-time (HTST) pasteurizer for continuous liquid food processing. Regulatory compliance requires monitoring of holding tube temperature and flow diversion.

tags.name: Holding Tube Temperature
tags.description: Temperature in the holding tube. Must meet regulatory minimum (161°F for 15 sec for HTST milk).

tags.name: Product Flow Rate
tags.description: Product flow rate. Determines holding time in the holding tube.

tags.name: Flow Diversion Device
tags.description: Flow diversion valve status. Diverts under-processed product when temp is below minimum.

tags.name: Raw Product Inlet Temp
tags.description: Incoming raw product temperature.

tags.name: Discharge Temperature
tags.description: Pasteurized product temperature at discharge.

sub_industries.name: CIP (Clean-In-Place) Systems
sub_industries.description: Automated sanitation systems that clean process equipment in place without disassembly, critical for food safety compliance.

device_types.name: CIP System
device_types.description: Automated cleaning system circulating caustic, acid, and rinse solutions through process equipment. Monitoring ensures sanitation efficacy and chemical concentrations.

tags.name: Solution Temperature
tags.description: Cleaning solution temperature. Minimum temps required for effective sanitation (typically 160°F for hot CIP).

tags.name: Flow Rate
tags.description: Solution flow rate ensuring adequate turbulence for mechanical cleaning action.

tags.name: Conductivity
tags.description: Solution conductivity used to verify chemical concentration and detect phase transitions.

tags.name: Supply Pressure
tags.description: CIP supply pressure ensuring adequate flow to all cleaning points.

tags.name: CIP Phase
tags.description: Current CIP cycle phase: pre-rinse, caustic wash, intermediate rinse, acid wash, final rinse.
